- The edges of the tampered area, particularly around the hairline and jaw, may exhibit signs of blurring or distortion.
- There may be inconsistencies in lighting and shadows across the tampered area, not matching the natural lighting present on the untampered parts of the image.
- The facial features within the tampered area could display unnatural symmetry or proportions that do not align with the rest of the head or body.
- If there are accessories like glasses or earrings, the tampered area may show irregularities in the reflections or how they interact with the light.
